consumer: The frontend paperdoll renderer reading avatar.carried_items[] to ask 'which item is in the wielded slot and which items fill each worn slot', held as raw per-slot state to draw the doll.
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded + worn + inventory), not nearby ground items or a map region
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items — iterates ctx.u.wielded_items(), ctx.u.worn, and inv_const_slice(), serializing each raw item with a location tag ('wielded'|'worn'|'inventory') directly from the character's own containers, not computing a predicate or a display-filtered view.
divergence: Avatar wields a knife and wears a jacket; the snapshot mislabels the knife's location as 'worn' (or drops the jacket / pulls in a ground item from map::i_at), so the paperdoll renders the weapon in an armor slot, diverging from the actual wielded_items()/worn containers.
